description: A white two-piece knob-like furniture part sits on the green bedspread in front of a dark blue pillow. The left hand comes in from the lower left to steady the square base while the right hand reaches in from the lower right to grip the rounded top; the right hand lifts and pulls the top piece to the right, separating it from the base, then releases it so it rests on its side while the left hand lets go and withdraws.
